dict.string: RPI Central uses calendar access to mirror events from selected Google, Outlook, and other calendars into your RPI Central calendar.
RPI Central uses the camera to scan paper syllabi so it can find exam and due dates. Scans stay on your iPhone.

With background sharing on, RPI Central updates the location you share with friends after you move a significant distance or arrive at a part of campus, even when the app is closed. Turn it off anytime in Social › Map.
Precise location lets friends see which campus building you are in.
RPI Central shows where you are on the friends map and, only when you turn on location sharing, shares it with the friends you choose.
